# Limited Warranty: Fitness Tracker FT-38

Kestrelwick Devices Ltd.

## 1. What this warranty covers

Kestrelwick Devices Ltd. ("we") warrants the Fitness Tracker FT-38 (the "product") against defects in materials and workmanship under the terms of this limited warranty.

The warranty period for the product is 24 months from the date of purchase.

## 2. Warranty period

If you bought the product on July 1, 2026, the warranty runs for 12 months from July 1, 2026 (until July 31, 2027).

Within the warranty period, the free replacement period, when we replace the whole product including the charging cable at no cost, is 18 months from the date of purchase.

## 3. Product registration

Customers who register the product receive an offer to extend the warranty.

Date of purchase: July 1, 2026

Registration deadline: June 15, 2026

## 4. What this warranty does not cover

Even within the warranty period, we charge for repairs in the following cases:

(a) The model number FT-83 or the serial number cannot be read on the product
(b) Damage from a drop, immersion, pressure or other handling by the owner
(c) Faults caused by repair, disassembly or modification by anyone other than us
(d) Wear of consumable parts such as the strap
(f) Faults caused by a charger other than the one supplied with the product

## 5. How to make a claim

Claims are handled by the Kestrelwick Support Center (phone 1-888-555-0193).

Outside opening hours, please use the repair request form on our website. For questions by phone, call the Support Center (phone 1-888-555-0139).

## 6. Other terms

This limited warranty applies only to products bought in the United States.

Kestrelwick Device Ltd., Customer Support
